name: JINXAI ORBITAL
idea_statement: Take a short description and return a 1024px editorial portrait by expanding it into a full photographic prompt and rendering it on an 8-step distilled core.

platform.why: The app executes on the host's node graph, so the graph is the product. The private render deck stays behind a key and is never part of this listing.

sampler.note: Distilled core. CFG 1.0 with a zeroed negative is guidance off, which is what the brief asks for.

resolution.note: Sizes are multiples of 16; the latent grid patchifies 8x2.

lora.rule: A stack member at strength 0 is skipped. Triggers go first in the assembled prompt; they are the only part the user cannot override.
lora.economics_note: Two members from the same creator count once for incentive purposes.

inputs.label: Who or what
inputs.default: a navigator with freckles and a blunt bob
inputs.placeholder: a navigator with freckles and a blunt bob

inputs.label: Scene and light
inputs.default: at a station viewport above a ring city, soft morning light
inputs.placeholder: at a station viewport above a ring city, soft morning light

negative_note: Empty on purpose. At CFG 1.0 the negative branch is unused; a zeroed negative keeps the graph honest instead of pretending a negative prompt does something.

guardrails.why: The platform incentive requires a positive, healthy creative direction; an unfiltered app is not publishable under it.
